question: Who discovered blood circulation?
solution:
The correct answer is **__William Harvey.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **William Harvey** was the first person to correctly describe blood circulation in the body.
 
• He showed that arteries and veins form a complete circuit. The circuit starts at the heart and leads back to the heart.
